title: Looking for a collaborator to build a stock algo-trading bot
author: maheshnnaik
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’m looking for someone interested in collaborating on a project to build an algorithmic trading bot for stocks.

The idea is to build this properly from the ground up rather than jumping straight into live trading. I’m thinking of working through:

Strategy selection / defining trading rules

Historical data collection and cleaning

Backtesting different strategies

Performance and risk analysis

Paper trading

Eventually, if the results are consistent, exploring live execution

I have Claude Code access and I’m thinking of using it to speed up the development, experimentation, and testing process.

I’m primarily looking for someone who can contribute to the trading/strategy side — identifying potential strategies, defining rules, understanding market behaviour, and evaluating backtest results. Programming experience is definitely a plus, but it doesn't have to be the only focus.

I have software development experience, so I can take care of a significant part of the implementation.

The goal is to collaborate, experiment, and learn rather than assume we can immediately create a profitable system.

If you’re interested in algo trading, quantitative strategies, backtesting, or building trading systems, feel free to DM me with a little about your experience and what you’d like to work on.

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body:
Before recruiting around “strategy,” I’d write a one-page research contract for the first idea: universe, signal timing, holding period, benchmark, costs, and the conditions that would make you abandon it. That gives a collaborator something concrete to challenge and keeps Claude Code from rapidly generating variants after every disappointing result.

I’d also decide who owns the historical-data specification, especially split/dividend adjustments and delisted stocks, before backtesting. What market and timeframe do you want the first paper-trading candidate to target?

comments.author: Whole-Lunch-2628
comments.body: If you’re building the bot from the ground up, we can help develop the complete algorithmic trading system with **10 strategy models**, structured backtesting, risk controls, and paper-trading workflows. On the development side, we can handle details such as **event-driven execution, order-state management, slippage modeling, and strategy isolation**, which are often overlooked when moving from backtests to live execution. We can also build the architecture so new strategies can be tested without rewriting the core system.

comments.author: SuperOrbital_Trading
comments.body: You already have access to claude and are trusting it to code the bots behavior but you don't trust it to help you come up with a strategy?
